title: Train mishap and landing at Detroit's Club Harlem
summary: He is put off a Toronto train in Michigan and then goes to Detroit, where the Club Harlem hires him for 1933-37.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: '33, I think it was. I decided that...this guy came from Toronto and he had a ticket, a return ticket to Toronto. And he didn't want to go back to Toronto and he gave me the ticket. Well in those days it wasn't as easy to try to get from one...you know, like this man would accept you on your honest face. So I got on that train going to Toronto. When I got to the border the man asked me where I was going. I said, "I'm going back to Toronto." He said, "You live in Toronto?" "Yeah." He knew I was lying, you know. He says, "Where do you live." I told him. He says, "Where is somebody's store?" You know, one of them big department..."Simpson's," he asked me. I think it was Simpson's. "Where is Simpson's store?" My mouth was open. "Simpson's? I don't think I know where that is." He says, "Okay, you get off at the next stop."
So they put me off the train in Durand , Michigan. Well, here I am in Durand, Michigan again. I call a guy, I tell him to send me a ticket. He send me a ticket and I went

to Detroit. I walked into Detroit, to the Club Harlem which was supposed to be owned by gangsters now...you know how people is. I asked the guy.................. , he asked me where I was from, I said, "Chicago." you know? I called a few names, he said, 'You start...... 'work tonight,' and I stayed in Detroit '33 to '37. And I worked around Detroit and I had an opportunity again to meet a lot of...Now, what I was doing is, I'd only been meeting like territorial bands in the beginning, from the beginning, you know. It was an amateur show and the next was the territory bands...there were Trent and those guys.
